summary: Explains how controller capacity decides how many jobs an instance can run, based on mem_capacity and cpu_capacity versus job impact; capacity is shared across instance groups, and on a single available instance the Task Manager lets a job run even past capacity so it does not get stuck.
questions: How does automation controller decide how many jobs can run on an instance?
What is job impact in AAP capacity?
Why did a job run even though the instance was over capacity?
How does instance capacity affect instance groups?
